entities.name: Fernando Alonso
entities.description: Often regarded as one of the greatest F1 drivers in the history of the sport.

entities.name: Giancarlo Fisichella
entities.description: Said Alonso understands when to go faster and when to preserve his tyres in a race.

entities.name: Martin Brundle
entities.description: Former racing driver and Sky Sports pundit who described Alonso as 'Senna-like in his intimate feel for where the grip is'.

entities.name: Jody Scheckter
entities.description: 1979 world champion who has criticised Alonso for causing problems in teams.

entities.name: Christian Horner
entities.description: Ruled out signing Alonso for Red Bull, as he caused chaos in previous teams.
